nodes.label: Passwordless auth
nodes.rationale: Magic link + 8-digit OTP; OTP path exists because installed iOS PWAs can't receive Mail links.

nodes.label: SPA fallback 404 redirect
nodes.rationale: GitHub Pages has no server routing; 404.html redirects to ?redirect= and index.html restores path before router mounts.

nodes.label: Row Level Security
nodes.rationale: All access enforced in Postgres; usePermissions() is UI-only.

nodes.label: Job visibility core rule
nodes.rationale: One predicate can_see_job reused by jobs and all child tables and job-photos storage policy.

nodes.label: Permission keys
nodes.rationale: Fixed growing list added via migrations, never a dynamic permission system.

nodes.label: Platform admin carve-out
nodes.rationale: Not a blanket bypass; each carve-out added individually. admin_access_log unwired until a second org.

nodes.label: Server-side business rules (triggers & RPCs)
nodes.rationale: Enforce column-change rules and atomic sequences RLS can't express.

nodes.label: enforce_job_completion_photo_requirement
nodes.rationale: Hard per-job photo flag enforced server-side, distinct from soft job-type confirm.

nodes.label: enforce_checklist_item_photo_requirement
nodes.rationale: Separate permission from whole-job bypass because per-item safety requirement warrants explicit grant; visible override button rather than silent checkbox.

nodes.label: delete_job
nodes.rationale: Only deletion path (no DELETE policy) keeps permission check in one place; storage objects removed by client.

nodes.label: forbid_job_activity_delete
nodes.rationale: job_activity is append-only except within delete_job's transaction flag.

nodes.label: report_equipment_fault
nodes.rationale: One narrow audited RPC so repair-job creation can't drift between callers; doesn't weaken equipment_update policy.

nodes.label: forbid_role_delete_if_in_use
nodes.rationale: profiles.role_id is ON DELETE SET NULL and would silently orphan users.

nodes.label: jobs_sync_linked_parent
nodes.rationale: Done in DB so it happens however the job is closed, including offline.

nodes.label: Completion photo mechanisms
nodes.rationale: Three independent mechanisms: soft job-type confirm, hard per-job flag, per-checklist-item requirement.

nodes.label: Linked jobs
nodes.rationale: handoff/needed warn but never block (per Andy); parent_subtask_id has no FK to avoid PostgREST PGRST201 embed ambiguity.

nodes.label: Equipment checkout concurrency
nodes.rationale: Partial unique index enforces one open checkout per unit; 23505 surfaced as friendly message.

nodes.label: Edge Functions
nodes.rationale: Use service role key, so each re-implements its own authorization; explicit CORS headers since missing ones fail silently.

nodes.label: Force-confirm invited email
nodes.rationale: signInWithOtp treats unconfirmed accounts as signups, rejected with signups disabled ('Signups not allowed'); root-caused via Zara.

nodes.label: login_context claim
nodes.rationale: Pathname-only gate let kiosk sessions escape to desktop app; app_metadata claim is server-written and unspoofable; App.jsx signs out on mismatch rather than distinguish stale from live.

nodes.label: src/lib/AuthContext.jsx
nodes.rationale: Skip reload when SIGNED_IN re-fires on tab focus for same user.

nodes.label: src/kiosk/ReportIssueForm.jsx
nodes.rationale: Footer 'pink ticket' copy is operationally meaningful; keep exact.

nodes.label: src/components/KeyReasonsModal.jsx
nodes.rationale: Generalised from ContractorReasonsModal once a second near-identical use appeared.

nodes.label: Field Journal design system
nodes.rationale: Spec snapshot as of Aug 2026; later replaced by Admiralty (BUILD-BRIEF §8).

nodes.label: Kiosk mode
nodes.rationale: 3-minute idle sign-out; no photo capability since photo-required templates aren't assigned to kiosk staff.

nodes.label: Offline support
nodes.rationale: Plain insert not upsert on flush; unique violation on client_generated_id means already synced.
